summary_en: KIMURA KOHKI raised FY2027 full-year dividend forecast by 40 yen to 240 yen per share, reflecting upward revision of earnings guidance driven by strong sales of factory zone air-conditioning units and other proprietary products.
title_en: Notification of Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, KIMURA KOHKI announced an upward revision of its FY2027 dividend forecast following stronger-than-expected interim results. The company raised the full-year dividend per share from 200 yen to 240 yen, an increase of 40 yen. This increase reflects the company's revised earnings guidance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, with net income per share now projected at 1,099.55 yen, compared to the previous forecast of 981.87 yen.

The earnings upgrade was driven by favorable sales trends in the company's high-value-added proprietary products, particularly factory zone air-conditioning units. During the interim period, revenue, operating profit, net profit, and earnings per share all reached record highs since the company's listing. The company raised full-year revenue guidance by 600 million yen to 20,300 million yen and operating profit by 555 million yen to 5,555 million yen.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's basic policy of securing necessary internal reserves for future business development and management strength while consistently implementing stable dividends and expanding shareholder returns. The company has established dividend policy based on profit distribution as a key management issue.
